name: Toritsuki ~Kanojo ga Akuma de Akuma ga Kanojo~
original_name: とりつき～彼女が悪魔で悪魔が彼女～
source:
"My osananajimi has been possessed by a devil...." Yasuharu soon visits Kusuha's house and meets a strange girl, Ril. According to Ril, she was just called to this world by Kusuha. Yasuharu tells Ril to get out of Kusuha's body, but she refuses.... Well, he decides to learn how to remove Ril out of Kusuha's body. According to a manual, it will take seven days to master it. Will he be able to save Kusuha...?

[Edited from ErogeShop]
translation:
“我的青梅竹马被恶魔附身了…”康晴立刻前往葛叶家，遇见一名叫莉露的奇怪少女。据莉露所说，她只是被葛叶召唤到这个世界。康晴要求莉露离开葛叶的身体，对方却拒绝了…于是，他决定学习把莉露从葛叶体内驱逐出去的方法。根据手册说明，掌握这项技术需要七天。康晴能够成功拯救葛叶吗…？

[编辑自ErogeShop]
